figures.name: Rishabhadeva

ability.name: First Ford-Maker
ability.description: All allies begin battle immune to the first three attacks from cosmic protection.

figures.description: The first Tirthankara who established civilization and then renounced all to attain liberation.

figures.name: Mahavira

ability.name: Ahimsa Absolute
ability.description: No violence can be directed at nature or creature allies while Mahavira is in play.

figures.description: The 24th and last Tirthankara whose radical non-violence and omniscient liberation founded modern Jainism.

figures.name: Parshvanatha

ability.name: Serpent Protection
ability.description: Summon a serpent hood over one ally: they absorb 5 damage before it reaches them.

figures.description: The 23rd Tirthankara whose multi-hooded serpent canopy protects him and who preceded Mahavira by 250 years.

figures.name: Bahubali

ability.name: Vine Meditation
ability.description: This card becomes immovable for 2 turns; in that time it absorbs all damage for all allies.

figures.description: The Jain hero who stood in meditation so long that vines grew up his legs, achieving liberation through stillness.

figures.name: Chakravarti

ability.name: Six Treasures
ability.description: Grant one ally six different +1 bonuses to six different stats simultaneously.

figures.description: The universal world emperor of Jain cosmology who possesses six divine treasures but must renounce all for liberation.

figures.name: Ambika

ability.name: Lion Throne
ability.description: Summon two lion guardians; grant all mother and protector allies +2 to all stats.

figures.description: The beautiful golden yakshi of the 22nd Tirthankara who protects devotees riding her lion throne.

figures.name: Dharanendra

ability.name: Divine Cobra
ability.description: Protect one ally completely for 1 turn with divine serpent hood.

figures.description: The naga king who protects Parshvanatha from rain and storms with his multi-hooded divine cobra canopy.

figures.name: Padmavati

ability.name: Lotus Seat
ability.description: Restore 2 HP to all allies; grant +2 magic to all Jain-aligned allies.

figures.description: The lotus-seated yakshi of Parshvanatha who protects Jain devotees and communities.

figures.name: Jinendra

ability.name: Victor's Power
ability.description: All Jain allies cannot be charmed or controlled by any means.

figures.description: The title Jinendra — Lord of Conquerors — applied to all 24 Tirthankaras who conquered inner enemies.

figures.name: Harinegameshi

ability.name: Sacred Transfer
ability.description: Move one ally's most important ability to another ally permanently.

figures.description: The divine figure who transferred Mahavira's embryo from a brahmin womb to a kshatriya womb at Indra's command.

figures.name: Manibhadra

ability.name: Merchant's Ward
ability.description: Prevent all theft or steal abilities from affecting your allies this turn.

figures.description: The great yaksha protector of merchants and travelers worshipped throughout Jain trading communities.

figures.name: Gomukha

ability.name: Bull Power
ability.description: All strength-based allies gain +2 power for 1 turn from bull energy.

figures.description: The bull-faced yaksha protector of the first Tirthankara Rishabhadeva.

figures.name: Neminatha

ability.name: Compassion Renounced
ability.description: All animal and creature allies gain +2 defense from protection.

figures.description: The 22nd Tirthankara who renounced his marriage when he saw the animals being slaughtered for his wedding feast.

figures.name: Siddha Soul

ability.name: Pure Liberation
ability.description: This card cannot be damaged, debuffed or affected by any ability from a state of pure liberation.

figures.description: The liberated Jain soul at the apex of the universe — pure, weightless, omniscient and eternally free.

figures.name: Jain Monk

ability.name: Five Vows
ability.description: This card cannot participate in violence; instead grant +3 to all ally magical defenses.

figures.description: The Jain monk who has taken the five great vows: non-violence, truth, non-stealing, celibacy and non-possession.

figures.name: Suparshvanatha

ability.name: Seventh Liberation
ability.description: Restore 3 HP to all allies from the seventh Tirthankara's cosmic compassion.

figures.description: The seventh Tirthankara identified by the seven-hooded serpent canopy that shelters his meditation.

figures.name: Shantinatha

ability.name: Peace-Maker
ability.description: Remove all conflict debuffs; no enemy can initiate a new attack for 1 turn.

figures.description: The 16th Tirthankara of peace whose symbol is the deer and who brings the tranquility of ahimsa.

figures.name: Kundakunda

ability.name: Inner Self
ability.description: Grant one ally knowledge of their pure self: immunity to all external stat reduction for 1 turn.

figures.description: The greatest Digambara Jain philosopher who wrote the Samayasara — the Essence of the Self.

figures.name: Leshya

ability.name: Color Change
ability.description: Change one card's alignment; their abilities shift to match their new color.

figures.description: The six karmic colorings of the soul from black (wickedest) to white (purest) in Jain cosmology.

figures.name: Time Wheel

ability.name: Cosmic Cycle
ability.description: All cards on the field age by 1 turn worth of effects: all timers advance.

figures.description: The great cosmic time wheel of Jain cosmology that revolves through ascending and descending half-cycles eternally.
